dct_description_sm: The Upscale Executive Housing Special Policy Areas designated on Schedule “A1” are considered to include appropriate characteristics to accommodate successful upscale executive housing areas. The supply of upscale executive housing is intended to compliment the development of prestige office buildings and businesses, and to make Brampton more attractive as the location of choice for business executives to encourage them to work and live in Brampton.
dct_title_s: Official Plan Schedule A1 Upscale Executive Housing Special Policy Areas
